name: LAMPF-0645
full_name: Los Alamos Meson Physics Facility Experiment E645
summary: LAMPF E645 searched for electron-antineutrino appearance from a stopped-muon neutrino source, preceding LSND with a segmented scintillator and tracking detector.
detection_principle: Positive-muon decay at rest supplied muon antineutrinos. Appearance candidates were sought through positrons and correlated neutrons from inverse beta decay, using fine segmentation and extensive active and passive shielding to reject accelerator and cosmic backgrounds.
